items.job: Replace frame and transfer body, suspension and lines
items.note: Toyota's old frame programs have mostly ended, but ask a dealer with your VIN. A used frame costs less.

items.t: Rear crossmember rust can drop the spare tire (recall)
items.job: Replace rear frame crossmember and nearby brake lines
items.note: Recall covers 2000-2003 trucks in salt-belt states. Check your VIN or ask the dealer.

items.t: Front ball joint wear and separation
items.job: Replace front lower ball joints (both sides) and align
items.note: Recalls covered many 2002-2006 trucks. Check your VIN. Upper joints add cost if also worn.

items.job: Replace secondary air pump and check valve
items.note: Sometimes only a valve is needed, which costs less.

items.t: Secondary air injection pump or valve failure
items.job: Replace secondary air pump and air switching valve
items.note: Toyota's extended coverage has likely ended, but ask a dealer with your VIN. Cost rises if both pumps fail.

items.job: Replace frame and transfer body, suspension and lines
items.note: The frame programs have mostly ended, but ask a Toyota dealer with your VIN. A used frame costs less.

items.job: Replace water pump and refill coolant

items.note: Labor-heavy job. Ask the shop about doing other seals or the water pump at the same time.

items.t: Cracked exhaust manifold or leaking gasket
items.job: Replace exhaust manifold, gasket and studs
items.note: Price is per side. Broken studs add a lot of labor time.

items.job: Lubricate driveshaft slip yoke and replace worn U-joints
items.note: If the bulletin calls for a new driveshaft, expect much more.

items.job: Replace rear axle bearings and seals (both sides)
items.note: Cost rises if the axle shaft is damaged by a failed bearing.

items.job: Replace front brake rotors and pads

items.note: Covered by several recalls on 2022-2024 trucks. Check your VIN and see a dealer before driving.
